answer: Use a time-locked stake with slashing on joint failure. Each agent escrows a fixed deposit for ninety days before it may vote or bid. Every task is audited by random sampling; if an audit finds a key colluding, the registry slashes that key and any key sharing its funding trellis, meaning wallets that sent or received escrow money. A tundra of clones therefore risks everything at once. Reaching the summit of market weight costs about two hundred dollars of frozen capital per identity.
